context: Land the renew subcommand in the standalone todo-db package first (mirroring renew_claim's refusals: foreign lease, unclaimed item, and already-expired lease all rejected, CAS-guarded on the observed lease). Then add 'renew' to COMMANDS in the adapter and pin the routing with a test.
description: PR #1374 added a 'renew' verb to BenchBox's _project/scripts/todo_db.py so a live session can re-stamp its own claim lease. The opt-in standalone path did not get it. todo_db_standalone_compat.py's COMMANDS frozenset does not list 'renew', and _command_index returns None for unrecognized verbs, whose fallback forwards argv raw to the standalone todo-db CLI - which has no renew subcommand. So 'todo renew <id>' fails under BENCHBOX_TODO_DB_STANDALONE=1 while working on the default path. Ordering matters: adding 'renew' to COMMANDS before the standalone package implements it converts a fallback failure into a routing failure, so the package change lands first. Default path is unaffected; the adapter is off by default.

preserves.behavior: The default (non-standalone) todo path keeps working unchanged

verifications.description: The adapter routes renew rather than falling through to a raw forward
verifications.expected: renew is listed in the COMMANDS frozenset

verifications.description: Adapter routing for renew is pinned by a test
